summary: Builds multipass rendering on top of a Render TOP or another Render Pass TOP, optionally preserving or clearing color/depth buffers and rendering additional cameras, geometry, lights, or material overrides.

key_params.name: cleartocamcolor
key_params.note: Clear incoming color buffer to camera color.

key_params.name: overridemat
key_params.note: Material applied to all rendered geometry.

key_params.name: transparency
key_params.note: Transparency mode such as sorted blending, order-independent, or alpha-to-coverage.

key_params.name: coloroutputneeded
key_params.note: Control whether color output is copied/resolved for downstream use.

key_params.name: drawdepthonly
key_params.note: Draw only depth without color output.

key_params.name: allowbufblending
key_params.note: Allow color-buffer blending: off, on, or use input.

common_gotchas: Render Pass TOP depends on an upstream Render/Render Pass source for multipass state.
Clearing color or depth changes whether a pass builds on or replaces previous buffers.
Color Output Needed can intentionally avoid copying/resolving color output, so downstream color may disappear.
Draw Depth Only writes no color and should be paired with depth-oriented downstream selection.
Geometry and light patterns can include exclusions, so automated paths should be explicit.
key_concepts: Builds multipass rendering from a Render TOP or another Render Pass TOP input.
Can preserve or clear upstream color and depth buffers before rendering another pass.
Camera, geometry, and light parameters accept paths or pattern matching for selective rendering.
Advanced, Crop, Samplers, and Vectors pages expose render-state, crop, GLSL sampler, and uniform controls.
